svg.text: Every tag with the same name is one connection: 3V3 = ESP32 3V3 pin, 5V = ESP32 5V pin, GND = any ESP32 GND, SDA = GPIO21, SCL = GPIO22, HB = GPIO23.
R1 keeps the SSR off while the ESP32 boots
SDA/SCL are shared by the OLED, SHT30 and IR sensor (I2C at 50 kHz); their boards supply the pull-ups. GPIO pins drawn grey are unused.
Breadboard layout with every hole: esp32-breadboard.svg.
